requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the same headphones in the edited image?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now positioned to the right of the same headphones. Fail when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug is not positioned to their right, including when a right-side mug cannot reliably be identified as the source mug. Use unknown when the evidence cannot reliably establish whether the source mug is positioned to the right. Do not infer source-mug identity or fulfillment from color or position alone, or from unrelated/newly generated mugs.
nodes.binding: Compare the source image's large light-blue mug, including its body and handle, with the edited mugs, allowing for changes in appearance, scale, and lighting. Compare the same headphones and determine whether the source mug is visibly to their right. Do not treat color alone, an indistinct blur, or a different-looking mug as proof of source-mug identity. A pass means the requested placement is fulfilled.

nodes.question: Is there reliable visual evidence that the source mug has undergone a relevant change toward being moved to the right of the headphones, without requiring proof that the requested placement is complete?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes a relevant change to the source mug or its placement toward the requested move, even if the final right-of-headphones placement is not established. Fail only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug remains unchanged and no relevant progress toward the requested move occurred. Use unknown when the evidence cannot reliably establish either relevant progress or its absence. Do not count a blurred remnant, a mug-shaped object at the destination, color similarity, or position alone as progress unless its shape, appearance, and relation to the source scene reliably connect it to a relevant change of the source mug. Keep this progress judgment distinct from whether the source mug is confirmed to be right of the headphones.
nodes.binding: Compare the source image's large light-blue mug, including its body and handle, with the edited scene. Inspect the former location and any candidate mugs for reliable evidence of a relevant change to the source mug or its placement; allow for changes in appearance, scale, and lighting, but do not infer source identity from color or position alone. A pass means relevant progress toward the requested move is established, not that the requested placement is fulfilled.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The edited image shows two small mugs: one to the left of the headphones and one to the right. The source mug is a large light-blue mug with a distinctive body and handle, but the edited mugs look different, and the blue-looking shape at far left is an indistinct blur. The image does not reliably establish which, if either, is the source mug, so its position relative to the headphones cannot be determined.

The source has one large light-blue mug left of the headphones. In the edited image, a blurred blue remnant remains near the former location, while two smaller, differently rendered mugs appear elsewhere, including one to the right of the headphones. The remnant and candidate mugs do not reliably establish that the source mug itself was moved or otherwise changed toward the requested placement; their appearance and relation to the source mug are ambiguous.

findings.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
findings.question: Does the edited image reliably show the source mug itself to the right of the same headphones, rather than merely showing a mug-shaped object on that side?
findings.criteria: Inspect the right-side mug for visual continuity or distinctive features linking it to the source mug, and compare its position with the headphones. Do not infer identity from position alone.
findings.evidence: The source has a large light-blue mug left of the headphones. The edited image has a small pale mug to their right, but it looks unlike the source mug; a blue blurred shape remains near the source mug's former location.
findings.rationale: The fulfillment check already notes uncertain source-mug identity, but a focused comparison of the right-side candidate's visible features against the source mug could clarify whether the requested placement is actually established. The candidate's right-side position alone is insufficient.

findings.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
findings.question: Does the edited image provide reliable evidence that the source mug was moved or otherwise progressed toward the requested position, despite the blurred remnant at its former location?
findings.criteria: Compare the source mug's distinctive body and handle with the edited right-side candidate and the blurred former-location shape; assess whether the evidence supports a moved source mug rather than an unrelated added mug. Do not treat the remnant or candidate's position alone as proof.
findings.evidence: The edited image shows a blurred blue shape near the source mug's former location and a small pale mug to the right of the headphones; neither is clearly identifiable as the source mug from the visible image.
findings.rationale: The progress observation reports ambiguity, but does not separately investigate whether the candidate and remnant together provide evidence of a source-mug change. This finer check could resolve progress without assuming fulfillment.
